name: Playlist Restrictor
description: Restricts playlist creation and editing to administrators, either for all non-admin users or only for users you pick.
overview: Prevents non-admin users from creating playlists via the Jellyfin API.

versions.changelog: Fix settings page: its script never ran on Jellyfin 12.4, so settings did not load and the user list stayed empty.
Choose which users are blocked (new 'Only selected users' mode with a user checklist). Default stays 'all non-admin users'.
